What We're Known For

The two dishes San Bernardino keeps coming back for.

House Specialty

Birria de Chivo

Goat birria done the Jalisco way — slow-simmered until tender in a deep, chile-rich consommé, served with onion, cilantro, and lime. This is the dish that made the kitchen a local favorite.

House Specialty

Menudo

A steaming bowl of traditional menudo in a rich red broth, finished with fresh onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime — the comfort classic done right.

Menu Highlights

Illustrative menu layout. Confirm current dishes, prices and ordering options with the restaurant.

Tacos

Classic street tacos on warm corn tortillas with onion, cilantro, and salsa.

Birria

Slow-cooked birria with its rich consommé for dipping — the heart of the menu.

Quesabirria

Cheesy, crispy birria tacos griddled to order, made for dunking in consommé.

Tortas

Hearty Mexican sandwiches on fresh telera rolls, stacked and pressed.
